minecraft:written_book_content.author: Mika
pages:
Mika's diary

Saturday.

We finally started today. There are five of us: Ben, Jonas, Lena, Tim and me.

Our rules:
- no cheats
- no commands
- no wiki
- everyone plays for the first time

We wanted to figure everything out ourselves.

Ben said: 'Whoever cheats buys pizza.' We laughed.

Tim built the first cabin. I think it is the most beautiful cabin in the world.

minecraft:written_book_content.title: The Night
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Mika
pages:
The first night.

Ben said he saw someone. Far away, between the trees. Completely black.

Jonas said it was probably a creeper shadow or a bug. We ignored it.

We did not notice that it had been staring at us the whole time.

Late at night Ben went outside again. 'Just a quick look.'

We thought he was getting wood.

We fell asleep.

minecraft:written_book_content.title: The Morning
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Lena
pages:
Sunday morning.

Ben's bed was empty. His things were still there.

We thought he was sleeping somewhere else or had logged off early.

There was school. We had to go.

Tim said: 'He will show up.'

Nobody heard anything in the night. Nobody wanted to have heard anything.

We left the cabin the way it was.

There were tracks in front of the door. Tracks of ONE person, leading in and never out again.

minecraft:written_book_content.title: School
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Jonas
pages:
Monday at school.

Ben was not at his seat. We thought: sick. Overslept. Whatever.

None of us texted him. None of us called.

During break we talked about the game and laughed.

The strange thing: everyone else asked 'Who is Ben?'

As if he had never existed.

That should have warned us.

minecraft:written_book_content.title: The Poster
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Tim
pages:
After school we walked home together.

A sheet of paper hung on the lamp post in front of Ben's street.

MISSING

Ben

Last seen: Saturday evening
Description: wanted to step outside for a moment

Please get in touch.

In the photo he wore the shirt from our first night.

The photo was taken in our cabin.

None of us took it.

pages:
It learns.

Day 1: unknown
Day 2: unnowk
Day 3: ukwonoa
Day 4: HsiEpLdP

If you are reading this, it has already seen you.

Do not stare into the dark for too long.

It stares back.

We should have looked for him. We should not have slept.

If you hear footsteps behind you: run. And do not look back.
